notes.title: Casino FULL VERSION
notes.notes: Our game has been released as a full version. Our players' opinions will be taken into account in the game. New things will continue to be added.

notes.title: Big Update - Casino Simulator 2024
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011550/6ae4c6c033e72708b59c5a461a0619e8cfa58e76.png
Hello Gamblers!!

notes.title: Update - Casino Simulator 2024
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011550/1f26d8a861cd72b98f6f28aef5465ffa858467cf.jpg

Hello Gamblers!!
Thank you for supporting us in the development process of our game. We are sharing the first update to be made this month.

- You will be able to distribute brochures in the game and advertise your casino. You will gain more customers from these advertisements.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011550/22d3e6251a0cf36e3c27b3c400e1babe949755a5.png

- Your customers in the casino may cheat. You will need to expel them from your casino.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011550/a055d1fb5d0e79d137fbd46532174fc9895d9eb0.png
- Camera and alarm systems have been added to detect cheaters in your casino. You can buy these systems from the store.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011550/8afe5fa9ae4048aa2ba68758eb76c9281a4692fb.png
- There is now a mafia in the game. This mafia will ask for tribute from you on some days. If you do not pay the tribute, it will damage your casino.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011550/44591875657a9343bb3632f790cc515b39fc9e16.png

- Sign advertising systems have been added to the game.
- Online Casino earnings have been increased.
- Toilets can now be opened at level 1.
- Slot and table sound adjustment features have been added to the settings
- Some areas in the game have been made more descriptive.
- You will now be able to sleep in your new home.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2836450/Casino_Simulator_2024/

What we plan to do in the next update.

- New levels.
- New areas.
- New tables.
- New decorations.
- New games.
- New casino improvements.

We take into account the requests of our community and welcome your comments during the development phase.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011550/eded40b341881d2865ed86d8f697f38f092a94b5.png

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011550/1f26d8a861cd72b98f6f28aef5465ffa858467cf.jpg
 Hello, Gamblers !!

We are sharing the first update in our game with you.
Some bugs were fixed based on the feedback we received from game owners.


- Increased customer seating times
- Fixed typos.
- New lamps added.
- Added a close button to the Paint menu.
- Updated music on the laptop.
- Increased decoration limits.
- Added a warning for purchase restrictions.
- Fixed some bugs in the building system.
- Blackjack and roulette game names have been added
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011550/6a3011113fc6d598e88009331e77fb2718e1ae31.jpg


Follow us to be informed about more updates. You can send us the bugs you see and the features you want to be added to our discord address.
